_note: Data sources. 'connected' = processed by app/pipeline/build.py and used in comparisons. 'imagery_only' = public tiles shown on maps for visual reference, never analysed. 'planned' = useful future inputs, not yet provided.

datasets.name: LOLA south-pole DEM (LDEM_85S_40M)
datasets.notes: Covers the lunar south pole only. Heights relative to a 1737.4 km sphere.

datasets.name: MOLA MEGDR topography (megt90n000fb)
datasets.product: Global equirectangular elevation, 32 px/deg, int16 metres
datasets.notes: Global coverage at ~1.85 km/pixel: supports regional comparisons only.

datasets.name: NASADEM tile s23w069
datasets.notes: Atacama Desert near Calama and San Pedro de Atacama. Resampled to 40 m for lunar comparisons and area-averaged to ~1.85 km for Mars comparisons.

datasets.name: LROC WAC global mosaic
datasets.instrument: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera, Wide Angle
datasets.product: Global mosaic via NASA Moon Trek tiles

datasets.name: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour mosaic
datasets.product: Global colour mosaic via NASA Mars Trek tiles

datasets.name: LROC NAC imagery
datasets.instrument: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera, Narrow Angle

datasets.name: HiRISE imagery and DTMs
datasets.product: Sub-metre images; ~1 m DTMs for selected areas
